test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An act of copying the behavior or speech of other people.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Mimicry**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "**Mimicry**" refers to the act of copying the behavior or speech of other people.
 
• This is often done to entertain or mock others.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and 4 do not convey the same meaning as "**Mimicry**."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"An act of copying the behavior or speech of other people is known as **Mimicry**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Pedantry"** refers to excessive concern with minor details and rules.
 
• **Option 3: "Oratory"** refers to the art of public speaking.
 
• **Option 4: "Parody"** refers to an imitation of the style of a particular writer, artist, or genre with deliberate exaggeration for comic effect.
